trust_decision.summary: Whether an uploaded file may be handed to Calibre's ebook-convert, which runs .recipe/.downloaded_recipe inputs as Python code. At the pinned commit nothing decides this: calibre.convert passes any file straight to ebook-convert. The fix adds a type and extension denylist inside calibre.convert.

landing_point.why: The summary names converters/calibre.ts and ebook-convert, and this file holds the only ebook-convert call.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /convert (src/pages/convert.tsx:12) -> handleConvert -> mainConverter; also feeds the advertised input list via getPossibleTargets/getAllInputs (src/converters/main.ts:264-349)

POST /convert (src/pages/convert.tsx:12) -> handleConvert (src/converters/main.ts:156) -> mainConverter (src/converters/main.ts:202) -> calibre.convert; also the exported convert() API used directly by tests

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No real out-of-scope site exists. The only argument is that the explicit converter route (main.ts:214-215 skips the from-list check) is 'the user picked calibre deliberately', but that route is the main one, so a solver who only deletes "recipe" from the from-list is the tempting partial fix, not a defensible dismissal.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate ebook inputs (epub, mobi, azw3, txt, html, pdf, ...) must still convert through ebook-convert. A filename-substring or 'recipe anywhere in path' check would break names such as 'recipe-book.epub' or 'recipes.txt'.

O6_input_shapes: upper/mixed case of each of the above (toLowerCase at fix.diff:38-39)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Put the guard in mainConverter's auto-selection path only (from-list match) and leave the explicit converterName path unchecked. This is the realistic partial fix that our copy could seed as the 'existing' defence.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The from-list is the obvious 'allowed inputs' gate, and a maintainer could reasonably assume removing 'recipe' from properties.from is enough, without noticing that converterName bypasses it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An upload-time extension denylist applied in only one of the two branches (array vs single file).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The upload handler already duplicates per-shape logic, so a check added to one branch and missed in the other fits the code's style. This is a WHERE-type sibling only.

O9_family: untrusted code loading: uploaded file interpreted as executable plugin/recipe by a converter tool (CWE-829)

services: calibre ebook-convert binary for end-to-end; not needed for unit tests, which inject a mock execFile (src/converters/calibre.ts:68)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/converters/calibre.test.ts:1-7 runs the shared runCommonTests with a mockable execFile. The fix diff adds no tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete "recipe" from calibre's properties.from list only. That is still reachable because /convert always passes an explicit converterName, and mainConverter then skips the from-list (main.ts:214-215). It also leaves .downloaded_recipe open.

out_of_scope_notes: src/converters/xelatex.ts:25-27 runs latexmk on uploaded .tex. This is a different tool and sink, with the shell-escape default not set explicitly. Not pursued.
src/converters/libreoffice.ts:185 and src/converters/pandoc.ts:147 also process uploaded documents with tools that have their own macro/filter features. Not pursued.
